summary: Silvercorp Metals filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report, US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) furnishing a November 3, 2026 news release updating the El Domo Project construction budget and schedule. The capital budget rises to $298.2 million, up $14.6 million from the February 4, 2026 estimate of $283.6 million, driven by Ecuador diesel subsidy removal, water-management infrastructure, power supply and plant costs, partly offset by $9.8 million of savings. Heavy rainfall delays completion four months, with production forecast November 1, 2027. This is a routine operational project update, not a special situation; watch cost overruns and schedule slippage.
